card.name: Amounts just before a unit of volume
card.fires_on: Size or number words (small, a digit, half, trillion) that come right before a container or volume unit like barrels, gallons, cubic metres, teaspoon or vessel. Mostly about oil, mud, water or other liquids.

modes.label: Digits in big volume figures
modes.description: The last digit of a large number of barrels, gallons or cubic metres of oil or mud.
modes.example: In 1895 the oil production of Kansas was 44,43<<0>> barrels.

modes.label: Small or fractional amount
modes.description: A size word or fraction before a quantity or vessel of liquid or other material.
modes.example: Place three or four seeds in the hole, add a<< small>> amount of water and fill with dirt.

modes.label: Scale word before volume
modes.description: A magnitude word such as trillion before a volume unit.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward a measure or container such as cup, piece or quantity.
card.plain: It fires on the amount word that comes just before a unit like barrels, gallons or a cup of some substance.
